To maximize the total reward in a bandit problem, it is necessary to explore the arms that have not yet been tested to estimate their underlying distributions, while also exploiting arms that have shown promise. Since "Lowest Reward" and "Intermediate Reward" have not been sampled, exploring one of them is the optimal next step to identify if they perform better than the already sampled "Highest Reward."
